messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if you have switched from another anxiety medication"
set: ["if you have switched from another anxiety medication", "if you switched to fluticasone from another steroid medicine you should not stop using it suddenly", "temporarily stop taking if you have surgery", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria", "seek attention if you have blue-colored lips", "tell doctor who prescribes rosuvastatin if another doctor increases the dose of another medicine you are taking", "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "do not share with another person even if they have same symptoms", "call your doctor at once if you have", "doctor may recommend another gout medication to take with allopurinol", "call doctor right away if you have weakness", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria (PKU)", "get emergency medical help if you have hives", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form", "get medical help right away if you have agitation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
